title: Runtime-Aware Pipeline for Vertical Federated Learning with Bounded Model Staleness

problem.claim: Communication overhead from frequent cross-party statistics exchange impairs VFL training efficiency.

gap.claim: Synchronous VFL incurs excessive communication overhead, while asynchronous VFL can introduce model staleness that may reduce learning accuracy.

contributions.claim: BS-VFL is an asynchronous VFL pipeline with bounded staleness that overlaps local computation and statistics transmission.
The paper analyzes convergence error and develops a general framework for deriving closed-form wall-clock time for BS-VFL.
The paper refines learning parameters to minimize convergence error while maintaining training efficiency.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The convergence analysis shows that BS-VFL can achieve a result comparable to synchronous VFL.
Experiments on real-world datasets report a 48%-90% reduction in training duration while preserving model accuracy.
The runtime analysis indicates marked communication reduction.

narrative_sequence.summary: VFL enables privacy-preserving collaboration by combining geographically distributed data features.
Communication is the primary training-efficiency bottleneck, and existing synchronous and asynchronous designs expose different tradeoffs.
BS-VFL pipelines local computation and statistics transmission with bounded staleness, prioritizing local updates before embedding generation.
The paper analyzes convergence error and wall-clock runtime, then refines learning parameters for performance.
Experiments report shorter training duration while preserving model accuracy.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the bounded-staleness bound.
